positiveAssertions: captured CA immutable against input/response mutation
actual provider assignment becomes Opaque Secret.ca.crt and OCI.certSecretRef
exact child digest and vendor verification retained
mixed registry authentication/TLS preserve both references and proper TLS keys
CA rotation advances existing receipt credential epoch and invalidates old ack
independent destination policy cloned against caller mutation

qualificationLimits: Catalog composition fixture injects OIDC metadata; it is not a production OIDC cryptographic end-to-end claim.
Canonical QA-key publication/offline crypto qualification remains a separate reviewed chain.
